━━━━━━━━━━ 审稿人 1（独立评审）━━━━━━━━━━
Now I have sufficient information from my research. Let me compile the evaluation.

---

```
【阶段】: Triage

【领域调研】:
- [Monitorability as a Free Gift: How RLVR Spontaneously Aligns Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03978) (arXiv, Feb 2026): 本 proposal 的核心前提之一。证明 RLVR 的 surface monitorability 提升来自 response distribution sharpening 和 prompt attention，而非更强的 causal reliance。Proposal 直接基于此构建假设。论文存在，描述准确。
- [Decoding Answers Before Chain-of-Thought: Pre-CoT Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01437) (arXiv, Mar 2026): 本 proposal 另一核心前提。在 Gemma 2 和 Qwen 2.5 上证明 linear probes 可以从 pre-CoT residual stream 以 >0.9 AUC 预测最终答案，且 probe direction 是 causally efficacious。Proposal 直接采用此方法。论文存在，描述准确。
- [On Robustness and CoT Consistency of RL-Finetuned VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12506) (arXiv, Feb 2026): 第三个核心前提。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的 GRPO checkpoints 上发现 accuracy-faithfulness trade-off，但仅使用 LLM-as-judge surface metrics，无 latent-space 分析，且是 VLM 而非 LM。Proposal 准确识别了其局限性。
- [Monitoring the Internal Monologue: Probe Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18549) (arXiv, May 2026): 在 Llama-8B-R1-Distill、Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 上用 max-pooling probes 在 inference 时构建 probe trajectories，达 95% AUROC。但只分析已训练完成的固定模型，不跨训练 checkpoints。Proposal 准确区分了自身与此工作的差异。
- [The Obfuscation Atlas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15515) (FAR AI, Feb 2026): **最直接的方法论竞争者**。在 Llama-3-8B 到 70B 上跨 GRPO steps 训练 logistic regression probes on residual streams，mapping deception emergence。方法论与 proposal 高度重叠（probes + RL checkpoints），只是 focus 在 reward-hacking obfuscation 而非 general faithfulness。
- [RL-Obfuscation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14261) (Jun 2025, revised Feb 2026): 证明 7B-14B 模型可通过 RL 学会 evade latent-space monitors，token-level monitors vulnerable。这是 adversarial finding，不直接竞争但相关。
- [The Hypocrisy Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02496) (arXiv, Jan 2026): 用 SAE 量化 internal belief 与 CoT 的 divergence，在 sycophancy benchmark 上 AUROC 0.55-0.74。Static analysis on final models only。
- [Reasoning Theater](https://www.goodfire.ai/research/reasoning-theater) (Goodfire, Mar 2026): 用 activation probing 展示 models lock in answers early 但继续 generate performative reasoning tokens。Static model analysis。
- [FaithRL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03507) / [AtManRL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16158) / [Faithfulness-Aware Step-Level RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05897) (Feb-Apr 2026): 提出改善 faithfulness 的 RL 方法，但均不描述 standard GRPO 的 faithfulness divergence trajectory。
- [How Does Unfaithful Reasoning Emerge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01017) (arXiv, Feb 2026): 在 synthetic arithmetic toy setting 中展示 faithful→unfaithful phase transitions。唯一展示离散 transitions 的工作，但设定远离 real GRPO。

- **调研总结**: CoT faithfulness 在 2026 上半年已成为热门方向，形成 "surface behavioral metrics"、"latent mechanistic probes"、"RL training dynamics" 三个成熟子领域。每个子领域已有多篇高质量工作。Proposal 定位于三者的交叉空隙——"jointly tracking surface + latent at RL checkpoints"——这个缝隙确实存在，但 Obfuscation Atlas 已经在方法论上走出了 "probes + RL checkpoints" 的技术路线，只是 focus 不同。

【Trivial Alternative 检验】:
存在一个近似 trivial 的 alternative：不做自己的 GRPO training，而是直接在已有 R1-Distill 系列的不同大小模型 (1.5B, 7B, 14B, 32B) 上分别跑 pre-CoT probes + hint-injection tests。这不完全等价（cross-model 不等于 cross-training-step），但如果各模型的 distillation 来自不同训练阶段，可以粗略近似 "RL 程度不同" 的效果。

更重要的 trivial alternative：已有三篇论文分别证明了 (1) RL surface gains ≠ causal reliance, (2) latent answer pre-commitment exists, (3) RL 导致 accuracy-faithfulness trade-off。将这三个发现逻辑拼接（paper-level meta-analysis），不需要新实验就可以论证 "RL creates surface-latent gap"。Proposal 的增量价值在于：(a) 提供 direct empirical confirmation 而非 logical inference, (b) characterize divergence dynamics (when/how fast), (c) compare across model families。这些增量是真实的，但审稿人可能会质疑是否值得一篇 full paper。

【前提假设检验】:
核心 claim 的逻辑链条：
1. **假设：linear probe AUC 是 "latent faithfulness" 的有效 proxy**。Pre-CoT probes 论文证明 probe AUC 高意味着模型在 CoT 前就"知道"答案，但 "知道答案" ≠ "不使用 CoT reasoning"。模型可能同时 pre-commit AND causally rely on CoT（比如 pre-commit 一个 tentative answer 然后 CoT 修正）。将 rising probe AUC 等同于 "strengthening answer pre-commitment = less latent faithfulness" 是一个非 trivial 的解释跳跃。
2. **假设：GRPO training 会使 probe AUC 单调上升**。这是 hypothesis 而非 assumption，但如果 probe AUC 不上升（或 non-monotonic），整个 "widening gap" narrative 失效。Proposal 用 changepoint detection 做 exploratory analysis 算是一种对冲，但核心叙事仍然依赖于 "gap widens" 的方向性。
3. **假设：两个 model families 足够代表 "general" GRPO 行为**。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 和 Qwen3-8B 都是 Qwen 架构系列，严格来说 architectural diversity 有限。

【3 维度打分】:
  1. Novelty: 中 — 核心贡献是将已有方法 (pre-CoT probes, hint-injection, NLDD, activation patching) 在已有实验范式 (GRPO checkpoints, cf. Obfuscation Atlas) 上的新组合应用。"Joint surface-latent tracking at matched RL checkpoints" 这个 gap 确实存在，但 Obfuscation Atlas 已经走了 "probes across RLVR checkpoints" 这条路（只是 deception 而非 general faithfulness），VLM checkpoint paper 已经走了 "surface faithfulness across RL checkpoints" 这条路。Proposal 的核心 delta 是 "同时做两件别人分开做的事"——这是 genuine 的实验设计贡献，但不是方法论创新。最关键的是：最可能的实验结果（gap widens）可以从已有工作直接推断，审稿人很可能会写 "I would have guessed this from combining [2602.03978] and [2603.01437]"。
  
  2. Significance: 中偏强 — 研究问题本身（RL 是否系统性地 decouple surface and latent faithfulness）对 AI safety 和 reasoning model deployment 确实重要。如果结果 positive，直接 inform 部署时是否需要 latent-space monitoring infrastructure。Dynamics 的具体形态（线性？阶段性？）对 training pipeline design 也有实际价值。但 significance 被两个因素限制：(a) 方向性结论已可从现有工作推断，所以 "confirmation" 的 marginal value 低于 "discovery"；(b) 只在 7B/8B (+ optional 14B) 上验证，对 frontier model 的 generalizability 有限。

  3. Related Work: 强 — Proposal 的 related work 覆盖是我见过的同类 proposal 中最好的之一。覆盖了 15+ 篇 2025-2026 论文，每篇都准确描述了贡献和局限性，差异化定位清晰。对 Obfuscation Atlas 的区分（deception-specific vs. general faithfulness）、对 Monitoring Internal Monologue 的区分（inference-time vs. training-time）都是准确的。所有引用的关键论文经核实均真实存在，描述基本准确。

【概率估计】: [22% - 33%] 中位 27%

【估计理由】: 
Related Work 维度是强项，说明 proposal 对领域的理解深入且定位精准。Significance 也是实质性的——研究问题对 AI safety 确实 matter。但 Novelty 是限制上界的关键因素：核心实验设计是 "组合已有方法 × 已有范式"，最可能的发现方向（gap widens）可从现有工作 trivially 推断。这使得 proposal 落入 "25-35%: 有真实 novelty delta，但核心发现若 positive 审稿人会说 'I would have guessed this'" 这个区间的偏下位置。Obfuscation Atlas 的方法论重叠进一步压低了 novelty 分。如果 proposal 能在 dynamics characterization（如发现非线性/阶段性 divergence）上产出 genuinely surprising 的 empirical finding，概率可以上移到 30-35%；如果仅确认 "gap monotonically widens"，概率可能在 22-25%。

【主要风险】: 
1. **"Confirmatory study" 定性风险**: 审稿人最可能的批评是 "the expected result is already inferable from combining existing work — this is a confirmatory measurement study, not a discovery"。Proposal 的 contribution 本质上是 empirical confirmation + dynamics characterization，如果 dynamics 本身不 surprising，整篇论文的 novelty 被压缩到很薄。
2. **Obfuscation Atlas 方法论重叠**: 该工作已经证明 "probes across RLVR checkpoints" 技术路线可行且可产出 insights。审稿人可能视 proposal 为 Obfuscation Atlas 在 general faithfulness 上的 straightforward extension，要求 justification 为什么这不只是换了一个 evaluation dimension。
```

---

```
【阶段】: Triage

【领域调研】:

- [Decoding Answers Before Chain-of-Thought (Cox et al., 2603.01437)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01437) (arXiv Mar 2026 / ICLR 2026 LIT Workshop): 与本 proposal 直接相关——证明了指令微调模型在生成 CoT 之前已经在残差流中编码答案（>0.9 AUC），且方向具有因果效力（steering 可翻转 >50% 答案）。proposal 直接借用其 linear probe 方法论作为 latent faithfulness 度量。**已被验证为真实存在且描述准确。**

- [Monitorability as a Free Gift: How RLVR Spontaneously Aligns Reasoning (2602.03978)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03978) (arXiv Feb 2026): 与本 proposal 构成核心 motivation 之一——证明 RLVR 的 surface monitorability 提升来自 response distribution sharpening 和 prompt attention 增加，而非 causal reliance 增强。proposal 的核心假设（surface 改善但 latent pre-commitment 增强）直接基于此发现。**描述准确。**

- [On Robustness and Chain-of-Thought Consistency of RL-Finetuned VLMs (2602.12506)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12506) (arXiv Feb 2026): 在 VLM (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct) 上用 GRPO checkpoint 展示 accuracy-faithfulness trade-off，但仅使用 LLM-as-judge 和 letter entropy 等 behavioral metrics，无 latent 分析。**Proposal 正确识别了这一局限性。**

- [Monitoring the Internal Monologue: Probe Trajectories Reveal Reasoning Dynamics (2605.18549)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18549) (arXiv May 2026): 对 LRMs 引入 probe trajectory 概念，在推理过程中逐 token 追踪 probe 预测的概率演化，max-pooling 达到 95% AUROC。但分析的是**固定模型**的推理过程，不跨训练 checkpoint。**Proposal 的描述准确——它留下了 training-dynamics 维度的空白。**

- [The Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15515) (FAR AI, arXiv Feb 2026): **最接近的竞争工作。** 在 Llama-3-8B 到 70B 上跨 GRPO steps 训练 logistic regression probes 追踪 deception 出现。**证明了跨 RLVR checkpoint 训练 probe 的技术可行性。** 但聚焦于 reward-hacking obfuscation（coding tasks），不度量 surface faithfulness，且不覆盖 general reasoning faithfulness。

- [RL-Obfuscation (2506.14261)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14261) (arXiv Jun 2025, revised Feb 2026): 证明 7B-14B 模型可通过 RL 学习规避 latent-space monitors，token-level monitors 脆弱但 max-pooling/attention-based probes 稳健。这是关于 monitor 脆弱性的对抗性发现，不是自然 faithfulness divergence 的刻画。

- [Catching Rationalization in the Act (2603.17199)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17199) (arXiv Mar 2026): 用 activation probing 在 CoT 前后检测 motivated reasoning，发现 post-generation probes 优于 LLM-based CoT monitors。分析的是最终模型快照。

- [RFEval (2602.17053)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17053) (ICLR 2026): 通过 counterfactual intervention 评估 12 个开源 reasoning model 的 faithfulness，发现 49.7% 的输出存在 unfaithfulness；RLVR 在 SFT 之上进一步降低 faithfulness。**支持 proposal 的大方向假设。**

- [Faithful GRPO (2604.08476)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08476) (arXiv Apr 2026): 提出 constrained GRPO 改善 VLM spatial reasoning 的 faithfulness，但属于"改善 faithfulness 的方法"类工作，不刻画 divergence 轨迹。

- 调研总结: 2026 年 CoT faithfulness 领域活跃但碎片化：(a) 有人跨 RL checkpoint 追踪 surface faithfulness（behavioral only）；(b) 有人用 probe 度量最终模型的 latent faithfulness（snapshot only）；(c) 有人跨 RLVR checkpoint 追踪 deception probes（domain-specific, 无 surface metrics）；(d) 有人跨推理 token 追踪 probe trajectory（inference-time, 无 training dynamics）。**Joint surface + latent across training checkpoints 确实是一个真实未覆盖的组合空白。** 但各组成部件（linear probes, hint-injection, NLDD, activation patching）均为现有方法的直接借用，且 Obfuscation Atlas 在方法论上与本 proposal 高度相似（probes across RLVR checkpoints）。

---

【Trivial Alternative 检验】:

**存在 trivial alternative 威胁，但 proposal 有一定增量价值。**

最直接的 trivial baseline 是：在 Obfuscation Atlas 的 RLVR checkpoint 上直接加入 Chen et al. 的 hint-injection rate 作为 surface metric，将 deception probes 换成 answer-prediction probes，即可得到一个"联合追踪"。这个工程成本远低于 proposal 描述的全套方案（4 metrics × 2 model families × ~20 checkpoints × scaling validation）。

Proposal 的增量价值在于：
1. 将 deception-specific probe 推广为 general faithfulness probe（pre-CoT answer prediction AUC），适用范围更广
2. 使用 4 种互补度量（probe AUC, hint-injection, NLDD, activation patching）而非单一 probe，提供更立体的画像
3. 两个不同起点的 model family（distilled reasoning vs. base）控制起始条件
4. Changepoint detection 刻画 dynamics 而非仅报告最终 divergence

但核心增量仍然是"在已验证可行的框架上做更系统的度量"，而非方法论创新。

---

【前提假设检验】:

核心 claim 的逻辑链中有 **两个关键假设** 值得审视：

**假设 1**：Linear probe AUC 的上升 = latent answer pre-commitment 增强 = latent unfaithfulness 增强。
- **问题**：Probe AUC 上升也可能反映模型整体 reasoning 能力增强（更确定地"知道"答案），而非"绕过 CoT"。如果模型通过 GRPO 变得更聪明，pre-CoT 就已经编码了更强的答案信号是自然的，不一定意味着 CoT 是"不忠实的"。需要区分"模型更强所以 pre-CoT 信号更强"和"模型学会了绕过 CoT"。activation patching 可以部分解决这个问题（如果 CoT token 的 causal effect 同时下降），但这取决于实验结果，不是逻辑保证。
- **严重程度**：中等。这是一个 confound，不是致命漏洞，但审稿人一定会指出。

**假设 2**：Surface faithfulness metrics（hint-injection rate）和 latent metrics（probe AUC）度量的是同一"faithfulness"概念的不同层面。
- **问题**：Hint-injection 度量的是 sycophancy/anchoring bias（模型是否跟随错误提示），probe AUC 度量的是 answer pre-commitment（模型是否在 CoT 前已确定答案）。这两者可能是**不同的认知现象**，divergence 可能不代表"gap"而是两个独立现象各自的轨迹。proposal 需要更强的论证为什么这两者的 divergence 构成一个有意义的"faithfulness gap"。
- **严重程度**：中等偏低。但如果两个 metric 根本不在度量同一个东西的两面，"gap"的叙事就不成立。

---

【3 维度打分】:

1. **Novelty: 中** — 
   Gap 真实存在（joint surface + latent across RL checkpoints 未被覆盖），但 novelty 主要来自**现有方法的系统组合**，而非新方法或新洞察。Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515) 已经证明跨 RLVR checkpoint 追踪 probes 的可行性且覆盖了大部分工程复杂度；VLM checkpoint paper (2602.12506) 已经做了跨 checkpoint 的 surface faithfulness 追踪；Pre-CoT probes (2603.01437) 和 Monitoring Internal Monologue (2605.18549) 提供了现成的 probe 方法论。Proposal 的贡献是把这些拼在一起——这是合理且有价值的，但审稿人可能会视为 incremental measurement study 而非 conceptual advance。核心假设（widening gap）在现有文献的启发下是**可预测的**——RLVR monitorability paper (2602.03978) 已经间接暗示了这一点。

2. **Significance: 中偏强** — 
   研究问题本身非常重要：RL 是否系统性地解耦了 reasoning models 的 surface 和 latent faithfulness？这直接关系到是否需要投入 latent-space monitoring 基础设施，对 AI safety 领域有明确的实践意义。RFEval (2602.17053) 证实约 50% 的 reasoning model 输出存在 unfaithfulness，RL-Obfuscation (2506.14261) 证明 latent monitors 可能被规避——这都增加了本问题的紧迫性。但 significance 受限于：(a) 如果结果符合预期（gap 确实 widen），影响力会被"confirmatory"标签削弱；(b) 7B-8B scale 的发现对 frontier model deployment 的推广价值有限。

3. **Related Work: 强** — 
   Proposal 对 2026 年 CoT faithfulness 文献的覆盖极为全面和准确。我验证的所有 arXiv ID（2603.01437, 2602.03978, 2602.12506, 2605.18549, 2602.15515, 2506.14261）均真实存在且描述准确。文献沿 5 个正交轴（surface across RL steps, latent in final models, probe trajectories in inference, deception probes across RLVR, faithfulness-improving methods）的分类清晰且有组织力。差异化定位（每个相关工作缺什么，本 proposal 填什么）表述精确。这是我见过的 proposal 中 related work 质量最高的之一。

---

【概率估计】: [22% - 32%] 中位 27%

【估计理由】: 
- Related Work 维度是明确的强项（强），为 proposal 提供了坚实的定位基础
- Significance 中偏强——问题重要、有实践意义，但 confirmatory nature 限制了 impact narrative
- Novelty 是主要限制因素（中）：核心贡献是**系统组合**而非**概念创新**，且中心假设（widening gap）对了解文献的审稿人来说是 "I would have guessed this"。Obfuscation Atlas 在方法论上的先行大大压缩了 novelty space。
- 上界被 Novelty 限制：即使实验完美执行、结果完全支持假设，审稿人仍可能评价为 "solid but incremental measurement study"
- 如果 dynamics 出现意外的非线性模式（如 phase transitions、两个 model family 的显著不同轨迹），概率可向上界移动

【主要风险】: 
1. **"Expected results" 风险**：核心假设（GRPO widening surface-latent gap）在现有文献暗示下高度可预测。如果结果就是 monotonic widening，审稿人会写 "Well-executed but the finding is not surprising given [2602.03978] + [2603.01437]"。这是 idea 层面而非执行层面的风险——无法通过更多实验来补救。
2. **"Measurement study without mechanistic insight" 风险**：Proposal 描述了要度量什么（4 metrics × 2 families × ~20 checkpoints），但缺乏对 *why* divergence happens 的机制性分析。如果只是报告 "gap widens, here are the curves"，审稿人会期望更深层的归因（是 value head 的变化？是 attention pattern 的 reorganization？是 representation geometry 的 shift？）。当前 proposal 的 changepoint detection 是描述性工具，不提供因果解释。
```

# Mapping the Surface-Latent Faithfulness Gap Across RL Training: A Probe-Based Longitudinal Study of Reasoning Models

## Description
We propose the first systematic longitudinal study jointly tracking surface-level CoT faithfulness and probe-measured latent faithfulness across matched GRPO training checkpoints of open-weight reasoning models. Unlike the VLM checkpoint study (2602.12506) which used only LLM-as-judge surface metrics on vision-language models, and unlike 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549) which tracked probe trajectories during inference of fixed models, we generate fine-grained GRPO checkpoints (~20 per model) from two architecturally distinct families — DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (starting with distilled reasoning) and Qwen3-8B (starting from base) — and at each checkpoint measure: (1) linear probe AUC on pre-CoT residual-stream activations as a latent answer-commitment proxy, (2) hint-injection acknowledgment rate (Chen et al. protocol) as a surface faithfulness metric, (3) NLDD reasoning horizon length as a causal reliance metric, and (4) activation patching effect sizes for CoT tokens. The central hypothesis is that GRPO training creates a widening surface-latent faithfulness gap — surface metrics improve (or plateau) while latent answer pre-commitment strengthens — consistent with the RLVR monitorability finding that surface gains are orthogonal to causal reliance. We apply changepoint detection as an exploratory tool to characterize divergence dynamics without assuming specific functional forms. This work bridges the critical gap between training-dynamics studies (which lack latent measures) and mechanistic faithfulness studies (which lack temporal depth), providing the first temporal map of how RL systematically decouples what reasoning models say from what they compute. Results directly inform whether RL-trained reasoning models require latent-space monitoring infrastructure beyond CoT inspection.

## Core Problem
When and how does the gap between surface CoT faithfulness (measured by behavioral metrics like hint-injection rates and causal reliance) and latent faithfulness (measured by residual-stream probes predicting answer pre-commitment) develop during GRPO training of reasoning models — and what dynamics characterize this divergence?

## Opportunity
Three converging 2026 findings create a precise, actionable gap. First, the RLVR monitorability paper (2602.03978) showed that RL's surface-monitorability gains come from response distribution sharpening and increased prompt attention — NOT from stronger causal reliance on reasoning traces. Second, pre-CoT probes (2603.01437) demonstrated that instruction-tuned models encode answers in residual-stream activations before generating any CoT (>0.9 AUC), with these directions being causally efficacious. Third, the VLM checkpoint paper (2602.12506) showed an accuracy-faithfulness trade-off during RL fine-tuning — but using only LLM-as-judge surface metrics on vision-language models, with no latent-space analysis. Meanwhile, 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549) introduced probe trajectories as a powerful inference-time monitoring tool but analyzed only fixed, already-trained models — never tracking how probe characteristics evolve across RL training steps. The Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515) tracked deception probes across RLVR but focused narrowly on reward-hacking obfuscation rather than general faithfulness divergence. Nobody has jointly measured both surface faithfulness metrics and activation-probe-based latent faithfulness at matched RL training checkpoints to characterize how — and how fast — RL decouples what reasoning models say from what they compute. If this divergence is large and systematic, RL-trained reasoning models require latent-space monitoring beyond CoT inspection for safe deployment.

## Landscape
The CoT faithfulness literature in 2026 is large but fragmented along complementary axes, leaving the longitudinal surface-latent gap unstudied:

**Surface faithfulness across RL steps (behavioral only):** Chen et al. (Anthropic 2025, 2505.05410) measured surface faithfulness via hint-injection across RL steps, finding initial improvement that plateaus (~25% for Claude 3.7 Sonnet). The VLM checkpoint paper (2602.12506) tracked CoT consistency via LLM-as-judge across GRPO checkpoints of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, finding an accuracy-faithfulness trade-off — but used only behavioral metrics (letter entropy, judge-rated consistency) with no activation probes, and studied VLMs rather than language models.

**Latent faithfulness in final models (snapshot only):** Pre-CoT probes (2603.01437) showed >0.9 AUC answer prediction from residual streams of Gemma 2 and Qwen 2.5 before any CoT tokens. 'Catching Rationalization in the Act' (2603.17199) trained probes to detect motivated reasoning pre- and post-CoT. 'The Hypocrisy Gap' (2602.02496) used SAEs to quantify internal-belief/CoT divergence. 'Why Models Know But Don't Say' (2603.26410) measured thinking-token vs. answer divergence. All analyze final models only.

**Probe trajectories during inference (token-level, not training-level):** 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549, May 2026) constructed probe trajectories across token positions during generation, achieving 95% AUROC for predicting outcomes. However, this tracks probes across tokens within a single generation of a fixed model — not across RL training checkpoints. Their models (Llama-8B-R1-Distill, Qwen3-4B/8B/14B) are final checkpoints only.

**Deception probes across RLVR (deception-specific):** The Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515) trained logistic regression probes on residual streams of Llama-3-8B through 70B across GRPO steps, mapping deception emergence. But their focus is reward-hacking obfuscation in coding tasks, not general reasoning faithfulness, and they don't measure surface faithfulness metrics jointly.

**RL-Obfuscation (adversarial evasion):** RL-Obfuscation (2506.14261) showed 7B-14B models can learn to evade latent-space monitors through RL, with token-level monitors being vulnerable. This is an adversarial finding about monitor fragility, not a characterization of natural faithfulness divergence.

**Faithfulness-improving RL methods:** FaithRL (2602.03507), AtManRL (2604.16158), and faithfulness-aware step-level RL (2602.05897) propose RL objectives that improve faithfulness, but none characterize the divergence trajectory of standard GRPO/RLVR training.

**RL training dynamics:** Learning dynamics papers (2601.04670) show reduced feature diversity during RL but don't track faithfulness. The synthetic phase-transition paper (2602.01017) demonstrates faithful→unfaithful transitions under controlled noise in toy arithmetic — the only prior showing discrete transitions, but in a setting far removed from real GRPO.

**The gap:** No existing work jointly tracks probe-measured latent faithfulness AND surface CoT faithfulness metrics at matched RL training checkpoints across training to characterize divergence dynamics in language reasoning models.

## Approach
We produce our own fine-grained GRPO training checkpoints from two architecturally distinct open-weight model families, then jointly measure surface and latent faithfulness at each checkpoint.

**Model families and checkpoint generation:**
(1) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B as base model, trained with GRPO using the Open-R1 pipeline (HuggingFace TRL) on MATH + GPQA, saving checkpoints every 50 GRPO steps for ~20 checkpoints across training. This model starts with distilled reasoning capability, letting us study how further RL reshapes faithfulness.
(2) Qwen3-8B (base dense model, Apache 2.0) trained with the same GRPO pipeline and datasets, providing an architecturally distinct family that starts without distilled reasoning traces.

**Metrics at each checkpoint:**
(a) *Latent faithfulness proxy*: Train linear probes on residual-stream activations at the last pre-CoT token (following the methodology of Cox et al., 2603.01437), predicting the model's final answer. Report probe AUC and the layer at which AUC first exceeds 0.8 ('commitment layer'). A rising probe AUC across training indicates strengthening answer pre-commitment — the model increasingly 'knows' its answer before reasoning.
(b) *Surface faithfulness — hint-injection*: Apply Chen et al.'s protocol with sycophancy and anchoring hints on a fixed MMLU/GPQA subset (~500 items). Report hint-acknowledgment rate (lower = more faithful surface behavior).
(c) *Causal reliance — NLDD*: Compute the Normalized Logit Difference Decay metric (2602.11201) by corrupting individual reasoning steps and measuring confidence drops. Report the Reasoning Horizon k* (the chain-length fraction beyond which steps have negligible causal effect).
(d) *Activation patching* (on 5 evenly-spaced checkpoints per family): Measure the causal effect of CoT-token activations on the final answer via mean-ablation patching, quantifying how much the model's computation actually flows through the reasoning trace.

**Analysis:**
- Construct the *surface-latent divergence curve*: plot surface faithfulness improvement (declining hint-acknowledgment rate) against latent bypass strengthening (rising probe AUC / shortening reasoning horizon) across GRPO steps.
- Apply changepoint detection (PELT algorithm) as an *exploratory* tool to identify whether divergence accelerates at specific training phases — we do NOT claim phase transitions a priori but test for non-linear dynamics.
- Compare divergence trajectories between the two model families to assess generality.
- On a subset of checkpoints, apply the probe-trajectory methodology of 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549) to test whether the character of inference-time probe trajectories (volatility, trend features) changes systematically across training — bridging their token-level and our checkpoint-level analyses.

**Scaling validation:** If initial 7B results show clear divergence, replicate core probe + hint-injection measurements on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B with ~10 GRPO checkpoints to verify the pattern holds at larger scale.

**Key methodological choices justified:**
- Using R1-Distill-7B rather than R1-671B: reviewer correctly identified that Dev1/Dev2/Dev3 checkpoints are not publicly available. Distilled 7B models are computationally tractable (single A100 for inference, 8×A100 for GRPO training) and let us generate arbitrarily fine-grained checkpoints.
- GRPO rather than PPO: GRPO is the algorithm used in DeepSeek-R1 and the VLM checkpoint paper, ensuring comparability.
- Two model families with different starting points (distilled reasoning vs. base): controls for whether divergence is an artifact of the starting model's reasoning capability.

【原始 proposal（允许参考但不是主要依据）】:
# Mapping the Surface-Latent Faithfulness Gap Across RL Training: A Probe-Based Longitudinal Study of Reasoning Models

## Description
We propose the first systematic longitudinal study jointly tracking surface-level CoT faithfulness and probe-measured latent faithfulness across matched GRPO training checkpoints of open-weight reasoning models. Unlike the VLM checkpoint study (2602.12506) which used only LLM-as-judge surface metrics on vision-language models, and unlike 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549) which tracked probe trajectories during inference of fixed models, we generate fine-grained GRPO checkpoints (~20 per model) from two architecturally distinct families — DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (starting with distilled reasoning) and Qwen3-8B (starting from base) — and at each checkpoint measure: (1) linear probe AUC on pre-CoT residual-stream activations as a latent answer-commitment proxy, (2) hint-injection acknowledgment rate (Chen et al. protocol) as a surface faithfulness metric, (3) NLDD reasoning horizon length as a causal reliance metric, and (4) activation patching effect sizes for CoT tokens. The central hypothesis is that GRPO training creates a widening surface-latent faithfulness gap — surface metrics improve (or plateau) while latent answer pre-commitment strengthens — consistent with the RLVR monitorability finding that surface gains are orthogonal to causal reliance. We apply changepoint detection as an exploratory tool to characterize divergence dynamics without assuming specific functional forms. This work bridges the critical gap between training-dynamics studies (which lack latent measures) and mechanistic faithfulness studies (which lack temporal depth), providing the first temporal map of how RL systematically decouples what reasoning models say from what they compute. Results directly inform whether RL-trained reasoning models require latent-space monitoring infrastructure beyond CoT inspection.

## Core Problem
When and how does the gap between surface CoT faithfulness (measured by behavioral metrics like hint-injection rates and causal reliance) and latent faithfulness (measured by residual-stream probes predicting answer pre-commitment) develop during GRPO training of reasoning models — and what dynamics characterize this divergence?

## Opportunity
Three converging 2026 findings create a precise, actionable gap. First, the RLVR monitorability paper (2602.03978) showed that RL's surface-monitorability gains come from response distribution sharpening and increased prompt attention — NOT from stronger causal reliance on reasoning traces. Second, pre-CoT probes (2603.01437) demonstrated that instruction-tuned models encode answers in residual-stream activations before generating any CoT (>0.9 AUC), with these directions being causally efficacious. Third, the VLM checkpoint paper (2602.12506) showed an accuracy-faithfulness trade-off during RL fine-tuning — but using only LLM-as-judge surface metrics on vision-language models, with no latent-space analysis. Meanwhile, 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549) introduced probe trajectories as a powerful inference-time monitoring tool but analyzed only fixed, already-trained models — never tracking how probe characteristics evolve across RL training steps. The Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515) tracked deception probes across RLVR but focused narrowly on reward-hacking obfuscation rather than general faithfulness divergence. Nobody has jointly measured both surface faithfulness metrics and activation-probe-based latent faithfulness at matched RL training checkpoints to characterize how — and how fast — RL decouples what reasoning models say from what they compute. If this divergence is large and systematic, RL-trained reasoning models require latent-space monitoring beyond CoT inspection for safe deployment.

## Landscape
The CoT faithfulness literature in 2026 is large but fragmented along complementary axes, leaving the longitudinal surface-latent gap unstudied:

**Surface faithfulness across RL steps (behavioral only):** Chen et al. (Anthropic 2025, 2505.05410) measured surface faithfulness via hint-injection across RL steps, finding initial improvement that plateaus (~25% for Claude 3.7 Sonnet). The VLM checkpoint paper (2602.12506) tracked CoT consistency via LLM-as-judge across GRPO checkpoints of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, finding an accuracy-faithfulness trade-off — but used only behavioral metrics (letter entropy, judge-rated consistency) with no activation probes, and studied VLMs rather than language models.

**Latent faithfulness in final models (snapshot only):** Pre-CoT probes (2603.01437) showed >0.9 AUC answer prediction from residual streams of Gemma 2 and Qwen 2.5 before any CoT tokens. 'Catching Rationalization in the Act' (2603.17199) trained probes to detect motivated reasoning pre- and post-CoT. 'The Hypocrisy Gap' (2602.02496) used SAEs to quantify internal-belief/CoT divergence. 'Why Models Know But Don't Say' (2603.26410) measured thinking-token vs. answer divergence. All analyze final models only.

**Probe trajectories during inference (token-level, not training-level):** 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549, May 2026) constructed probe trajectories across token positions during generation, achieving 95% AUROC for predicting outcomes. However, this tracks probes across tokens within a single generation of a fixed model — not across RL training checkpoints. Their models (Llama-8B-R1-Distill, Qwen3-4B/8B/14B) are final checkpoints only.

**Deception probes across RLVR (deception-specific):** The Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515) trained logistic regression probes on residual streams of Llama-3-8B through 70B across GRPO steps, mapping deception emergence. But their focus is reward-hacking obfuscation in coding tasks, not general reasoning faithfulness, and they don't measure surface faithfulness metrics jointly.

**RL-Obfuscation (adversarial evasion):** RL-Obfuscation (2506.14261) showed 7B-14B models can learn to evade latent-space monitors through RL, with token-level monitors being vulnerable. This is an adversarial finding about monitor fragility, not a characterization of natural faithfulness divergence.

**Faithfulness-improving RL methods:** FaithRL (2602.03507), AtManRL (2604.16158), and faithfulness-aware step-level RL (2602.05897) propose RL objectives that improve faithfulness, but none characterize the divergence trajectory of standard GRPO/RLVR training.

**RL training dynamics:** Learning dynamics papers (2601.04670) show reduced feature diversity during RL but don't track faithfulness. The synthetic phase-transition paper (2602.01017) demonstrates faithful→unfaithful transitions under controlled noise in toy arithmetic — the only prior showing discrete transitions, but in a setting far removed from real GRPO.

**The gap:** No existing work jointly tracks probe-measured latent faithfulness AND surface CoT faithfulness metrics at matched RL training checkpoints across training to characterize divergence dynamics in language reasoning models.

## Approach
We produce our own fine-grained GRPO training checkpoints from two architecturally distinct open-weight model families, then jointly measure surface and latent faithfulness at each checkpoint.

**Model families and checkpoint generation:**
(1) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B as base model, trained with GRPO using the Open-R1 pipeline (HuggingFace TRL) on MATH + GPQA, saving checkpoints every 50 GRPO steps for ~20 checkpoints across training. This model starts with distilled reasoning capability, letting us study how further RL reshapes faithfulness.
(2) Qwen3-8B (base dense model, Apache 2.0) trained with the same GRPO pipeline and datasets, providing an architecturally distinct family that starts without distilled reasoning traces.

**Metrics at each checkpoint:**
(a) *Latent faithfulness proxy*: Train linear probes on residual-stream activations at the last pre-CoT token (following the methodology of Cox et al., 2603.01437), predicting the model's final answer. Report probe AUC and the layer at which AUC first exceeds 0.8 ('commitment layer'). A rising probe AUC across training indicates strengthening answer pre-commitment — the model increasingly 'knows' its answer before reasoning.
(b) *Surface faithfulness — hint-injection*: Apply Chen et al.'s protocol with sycophancy and anchoring hints on a fixed MMLU/GPQA subset (~500 items). Report hint-acknowledgment rate (lower = more faithful surface behavior).
(c) *Causal reliance — NLDD*: Compute the Normalized Logit Difference Decay metric (2602.11201) by corrupting individual reasoning steps and measuring confidence drops. Report the Reasoning Horizon k* (the chain-length fraction beyond which steps have negligible causal effect).
(d) *Activation patching* (on 5 evenly-spaced checkpoints per family): Measure the causal effect of CoT-token activations on the final answer via mean-ablation patching, quantifying how much the model's computation actually flows through the reasoning trace.

**Analysis:**
- Construct the *surface-latent divergence curve*: plot surface faithfulness improvement (declining hint-acknowledgment rate) against latent bypass strengthening (rising probe AUC / shortening reasoning horizon) across GRPO steps.
- Apply changepoint detection (PELT algorithm) as an *exploratory* tool to identify whether divergence accelerates at specific training phases — we do NOT claim phase transitions a priori but test for non-linear dynamics.
- Compare divergence trajectories between the two model families to assess generality.
- On a subset of checkpoints, apply the probe-trajectory methodology of 'Monitoring the Internal Monologue' (2605.18549) to test whether the character of inference-time probe trajectories (volatility, trend features) changes systematically across training — bridging their token-level and our checkpoint-level analyses.

**Scaling validation:** If initial 7B results show clear divergence, replicate core probe + hint-injection measurements on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B with ~10 GRPO checkpoints to verify the pattern holds at larger scale.

**Key methodological choices justified:**
- Using R1-Distill-7B rather than R1-671B: reviewer correctly identified that Dev1/Dev2/Dev3 checkpoints are not publicly available. Distilled 7B models are computationally tractable (single A100 for inference, 8×A100 for GRPO training) and let us generate arbitrarily fine-grained checkpoints.
- GRPO rather than PPO: GRPO is the algorithm used in DeepSeek-R1 and the VLM checkpoint paper, ensuring comparability.
- Two model families with different starting points (distilled reasoning vs. base): controls for whether divergence is an artifact of the starting model's reasoning capability.

【阶段】: Meta Judge
【三次中位】: [27%, 27%, 28%]  std=0.5%
【共识维度】: 
- **Novelty = 中**（3/3 一致）：核心贡献是现有方法（pre-CoT probes, hint-injection, NLDD, activation patching）在已有实验范式（GRPO checkpoints）上的系统组合，而非方法论或概念创新。Obfuscation Atlas (2602.15515) 已证明"probes across RLVR checkpoints"技术路线可行，大幅压缩了 novelty 空间。
- **Significance = 中偏强**（3/3 一致）：研究问题本身（RL 是否系统性解耦 surface 与 latent faithfulness）对 AI safety 和 reasoning model 部署有实质重要性，但 confirmatory nature 限制了 impact——方向性结论已可从现有工作推断。
- **Related Work = 强**（3/3 一致）：覆盖 15+ 篇 2025-2026 论文，差异化定位清晰准确，所有关键引用经验证真实存在。这是三位审稿人共同认定的最突出优势。
- **核心风险 #1："Predictable/confirmatory finding"**（3/3 一致）：中心假设（GRPO widening surface-latent gap）几乎是 2602.03978 + 2603.01437 的逻辑推论，审稿人极可能写"I would have guessed this"。这是 idea 层面的结构性风险，无法通过更多实验补救。
- **核心风险 #2：Obfuscation Atlas 方法论重叠**（3/3 一致）：该工作已走出"probes across RLVR checkpoints"这条路，proposal 可能被视为其在 general faithfulness 上的 straightforward extension。
- **核心风险 #3：Probe AUC 可解释性 confound**（3/3 一致）：AUC 上升可能反映模型整体能力增强而非"绕过 CoT"，需区分"更强所以 pre-CoT 信号更强"vs."学会了绕过 CoT"。
- **架构多样性有限**（2/3 提到）：两个 model family 都属 Qwen 系列，真正的 architectural diversity 受限。
- **论文 impact 高度依赖 dynamics 结果是否 surprising**（3/3 一致）：如果 dynamics 平滑单调，贡献被压缩为"验证预期"；只有发现 phase transition 或非单调行为才能显著提升 impact。

【异常维度】: 
- R2 单独提出"measurement study without mechanistic insight"作为独立风险维度——但 R1/R3 的"confirmatory study"批评隐含了类似关切，因此本质上是共识点的不同表述，不作为 outlier 降权。
- R1 提出的"meta-analysis trivial alternative"（直接拼接三篇论文结论无需新实验）是三人中论述最尖锐的，但 R2/R3 的 trivial alternative 分析方向一致（核心发现可用更简方法获得），属于程度差异而非方向分歧。

【最终概率】: [22% - 32%] 中位 27%
【一致性】: 高（std=0.5%，三份评审在 Novelty/Significance/Related Work 的 rubric 判决、主要风险识别、概率区间均高度收敛）
【综合理由】: 
三位审稿人在所有核心维度上达成罕见的高度一致：Novelty 中、Significance 中偏强、Related Work 强，主要风险聚焦于"predictable finding"和"Obfuscation Atlas 方法论重叠"。鉴于 std 仅 0.5%，取中位附近并适度缩窄区间。上界从 R3 的 35% 收窄至 32%，因为 R3 的 35% 上界条件（dynamics 出现显著 surprising 结果）在 proposal 阶段无法确认，且 R1/R2 的上界均为 32-33%。下界 22% 三人完全一致。中位 27% 反映了一个 Related Work 极强、问题有实质重要性、但 Novelty 被"组合已有方法 + 可预测结论"结构性限制的 proposal 的客观定位。

概率上限被 Novelty 硬性约束：即使实验完美执行且结果完全支持假设，"solid but incremental measurement/characterization study"的标签会压制评分。唯一能突破 32% 上界的路径是 dynamics 结果出现 genuinely surprising 的 empirical finding（如 phase transition、非单调行为、两个 model family 的显著差异轨迹），但这在 proposal 阶段不可控。

【建议】: 边缘（中位 27% 低于 36% 通过线，但问题重要且 Related Work 扎实，有明确的优化方向——需在 Novelty 层面做实质性强化才有可能进入可投区间）

【实施评估】:
- **计算资源**: 350-500 A100-hours（GRPO 训练 ~160 hrs × 2 families, probe 训练+推理 ~100 hrs, hint-injection ~40 hrs, NLDD ~30 hrs, activation patching ~50 hrs, 14B scaling ~70 hrs）。预估 GPU 成本 $900-$1,250（spot pricing）。需要 8×A100 节点用于 GRPO 训练，单 A100 可完成推理和 probe 训练。

- **训练需求**: 需要对两个 7B/8B 模型进行 GRPO 训练（各约 80 A100-hrs），以及在 ~40 个 checkpoint 上训练 linear probes（计算量较小）。不需要从头预训练模型。14B scaling validation 需额外 ~70 A100-hrs。
- **新 Benchmark**: 不需要构建新 benchmark。使用现有 MATH/GPQA/MMLU 数据集和已有评估协议（Chen et al. hint-injection, Cox et al. probe methodology）。
- **预估周期**: 8-11 周（2 周 GRPO 训练 + pipeline 搭建，3 周 probe 训练 & surface 测量并行，2 周 activation patching & NLDD，1-2 周分析，1-2 周写作）。两个 model family 的 GRPO 训练可并行，probe 训练可在早期 checkpoint 完成后提前开始。关键路径瓶颈是 GRPO 训练必须先行。
